Alpha.name: Alpha
Alpha.description: Alpha types share an orientation toward creating new ideas and information as a means of maintaining harmony in a socially shared world. Innate curiosity, balanced by a concern for the feelings and comfort of those around them.

Beta.name: Beta
Beta.description: Beta types share an active, driven orientation toward getting things done in response to a chaotic or resistant world. A fighting spirit, compelled by a sense of glory, honour and the need to prove oneself.

Gamma.name: Gamma
Gamma.description: Gamma types share an orientation toward marketing and bringing new ideas into acceptance, discarding what no longer works in a forward-moving world. A socially and commercially oriented quadra.

Delta.name: Delta
Delta.description: Delta types share an orientation toward protecting and improving the immediate environment for those within it. Practical idealism — making things genuinely better in concrete, lasting ways.

Researcher.name: Researcher
Researcher.description: NT types combine Intuition and Logic. Driven by systematic inquiry, theoretical modelling and conceptual precision. Alpha NTs approach the world with playful abstraction; Gamma NTs apply it toward competitive, real-world outcomes.

Socializer.name: Socializer
Socializer.description: SF types combine Sensing and Ethics. Warm, socially present, and attuned to the needs and feelings of others. Alpha SFs seek connection through extroverted Ethics; Gamma SFs maintain harmony through introverted Ethics.

Pragmatist.name: Pragmatist
Pragmatist.description: ST types combine Sensing and Logic. Action-oriented realists who prefer results over theory. Beta STs are driven by extroverted Sensing — fast-paced, risk-taking, tactical. Delta STs are driven by introverted Sensing — structured, methodical, grounded.

Humanitarian.name: Humanitarian
Humanitarian.theme: Enthusiasm for human welfare and meaning
Humanitarian.description: NF types combine Intuition and Ethics. Idealistic and people-centred, with a concern for the welfare, happiness and spiritual development of others. Beta NFs support unconditionally through introverted Intuition; Delta NFs bring harmony through extroverted Intuition.

EP.name: EP
EP.description: High energy, stimulus-seeking, flexible and spontaneous. Comfortable with ambiguity and change. Can struggle with follow-through and sustained routine.

EJ.name: EJ
EJ.description: Organised, decisive and driven. Natural leaders and initiators. Comfortable taking charge and setting direction. Can be inflexible or overbearing.

IP.name: IP
IP.description: Calm, adaptable and self-contained. Comfortable with inaction and observation. Steady under pressure. Can appear passive or disengaged.

IJ.name: IJ
IJ.description: Principled, precise and consistent. Strong inner standards and a stable worldview. Reliable but can be rigid or resistant to external feedback.
